# coolify_project (Resource)

Manages a Coolify project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_project" "example" {
  name        = "my-project"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the project.

### Read-Only

- `icon_path` (String) Storage path of the project icon uploaded in the Coolify UI. Read-only; not on Project create/update allow list. Present on GET /projects/{uuid} on Coolify >= v4.3.3; omitted from the list endpoint and older instances.
- `icon_storage_type` (String) Icon storage backend (`local` or `s3`). Read-only. Present on GET /projects/{uuid} on Coolify >= v4.3.3.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_project.example <project-uuid>
```
